name: colon-any
description: The `: any` type ANNOTATION is the uncounted sibling of the ratcheted `as any` cast (audit F-06-1). `: any` on a tenant key (organizationId), a money value, an auth field, or external input erases the type checker exactly as `as any` does — the leads.organizationId-widening class the as-any ratchet exists to stop, walking straight past it because that ratchet only matches the `as any` cast form. This freezes the annotation count over server/ and drives it DOWN. Remediate the tenant-key/money/auth subset first; lower baselineCount as annotations are typed away. New `: any` now fails CI.
lastBumpNote: 3019 -> 3018 on 2026-08-09: developer-vertical Stage 1 extraction. The `threshold?: any` annotation on routes-lot-pricing.ts's inline evaluateRules moved into the pure @shared/subdivision/lotPricing engine and was retyped to `number | string | boolean` (the lot_pricing_rules.rules schema type), so the annotation is gone from server/. Locked in per this ratchet's strictly-down rule.
